units.source_text: 髭黑大将闻知冷泉帝访玉鬘之事，大为担心，频频催促玉鬘退出宫去。

en.t: When General Higekuro heard that Emperor Reizei had visited Tamakazura, he became deeply worried and repeatedly urged her to leave the palace.

units.source_text: 玉鬘也生怕做出人妻所不应有的事情来，

en.t: Tamakazura herself was also afraid of doing something improper for another man's wife,

units.source_text: 在宫中不能安居，于是便造出种种必须退出的理由来，

en.t: and she could not remain at ease in the palace, so she devised various reasons why she had to withdraw,

units.source_text: 再由父亲内大臣等巧言劝请，冷泉帝方始准许她退出。

en.t: and after her father, the Minister of the Interior, and others pleaded with skillful words, Emperor Reizei finally allowed her to leave.

units.source_text: 他对玉鬘说道：

en.t: He said to Tamakazura:

units.source_text: “你今朝退出之后，

en.t: After you leave this morning,

units.source_text: 一定有人心生鉴诫，不肯让你再进宫来。

en.t: someone will surely take warning from this and refuse to let you enter the palace again.

units.source_text: 这真使我伤心之极。

en.t: That truly grieves me beyond measure.

units.source_text: 我比别人先爱上你，现在却落在别人之后，

en.t: I loved you before anyone else did, yet now I have fallen behind another man,

units.source_text: 要仰承别人鼻息。

en.t: and must live at the mercy of his wishes.

units.source_text: 我已变成从前的文平贞了！”

en.t: I have become like the old Bunpei no Sada!

units.source_text: 他真心地惋惜。

en.t: He lamented this from the heart.

units.source_text: 以前传闻玉鬘貌美，现在眼见其人，他觉得比传闻更美。

en.t: He had long heard that Tamakazura was beautiful, but now that he saw her with his own eyes, he found her even more beautiful than rumor had said.

units.source_text: 即使以前不曾有过恋慕之心，见了也不肯放过；

en.t: Even if he had never loved her before, one look at her would have made him unwilling to let her go;

units.source_text: 何况曾有此心，安得不嫉妒怨恨呢？

en.t: since he had loved her already, how could he possibly avoid jealousy and resentment?

units.source_text: 然而一味强求，深恐被玉鬘看成浅薄而厌弃他。

en.t: Yet if he pressed his demands too insistently, he deeply feared that Tamakazura would see him as shallow and come to despise him.

units.source_text: 因此便装出风流优雅的姿态，

en.t: Therefore he put on an air of refined elegance,

units.source_text: 和她订立盟誓，使她心悦诚服。

en.t: and exchanged vows with her, winning her willing acceptance.

units.source_text: 玉鬘诚惶诚恐，想道：

en.t: Tamakazura was filled with awe and anxiety, and thought:

units.source_text: “‘梦境迷离我不知’呀！”

en.t: Ah, truly, I do not know where dream and waking are blurred!

units.source_text: 辇车已经准备好。

en.t: The carriage had already been made ready.

units.source_text: 太政大臣与内大臣派来迎接的人都在等候出发。

en.t: The attendants sent by the Chancellor and the Minister of the Interior were all waiting to depart.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将也夹在里面，唠唠叨叨地催促动身。

en.t: General Higekuro was among them too, persistently urging that they set out.

units.source_text: 然而冷泉帝犹未离开玉鬘。

en.t: Yet Emperor Reizei still had not left Tamakazura's side.

units.source_text: 他愤然说道：

en.t: He said indignantly:

units.source_text: “如此严密地在旁监视，真讨厌啊！”

en.t: How hateful it is to be watched so closely right beside us!

units.source_text: 便吟诗云：

en.t: Then he recited a poem:
